description: This file is a PHP source file that generates the web interface for parental control reports, including filters, report display tables, and scripting for dynamic interactions and AJAX requests to fetch report data.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts the HTML table headers and summary for accessibility purposes based on provided column headers array.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX POST request to fetch report data based on selected mode and timeframe, then populates the corresponding table with the results and updates pagination and table headers.
